Return a greeting with a better one, or at least the same, for Allah takes account of all things.
Do not insult those they invoke besides Allah, lest they insult Allah in enmity without knowledge; every community's deeds are made pleasing to it.
Do not pursue what you have no knowledge of, for hearing, sight and heart will be questioned, and do not walk the earth exultantly; all such evil is detested.
Allah's servants are told to say what is best, for Satan sows discord among them and is a clear enemy to mankind.
Believers should not enter others' houses without welcome and greeting, must go back if told to, and may enter uninhabited houses that serve them.
There is no blame on the blind, lame or ill, or on eating in relatives' or friends' houses, together or apart, and people should greet one another on entering houses.
Enter the Prophet's houses only when invited for meals, leave after eating, ask his wives from behind a partition, and never harm him or marry his wives after him.
Believers must not put themselves before Allah and His Messenger or raise voices above the Prophet's; those lowering them are rewarded, and callers from behind the chambers should be patient.
Believers should make room in gatherings and rise when told; Allah raises the believers and those given knowledge by degrees.
